blocks.text: Cloud deployment models batate hain ke cloud services kis tarah muhayya (available) ki jati aur istemal hoti hain. Har model control, security (hifazat) aur lachak (flexibility) ka alag darja deta hai. Bare cloud deployment models yeh hain: Public, Private, Hybrid aur Multi-Cloud.

blocks.prompt: Cloud deployment models ki tareef kijiye, un ka farq aur misalein bataiye (exercise long questions 2 aur 8).
blocks.explanation: Deployment model batata hai ke cloud kaise muhayya hoti aur kaun istemal karta hai. Public: internet par kai idaron ke darmiyan share, teesra fareeq (third-party) provider chalata hai, maslan AWS; sasta magar kam mehfooz. Private: sirf ek idare ke liye, maslan bank ki apni cloud; zyada mehfooz magar mehngi. Hybrid: public aur private ka mel, maslan rozmarra kaam public par aur hassas (sensitive) data private mein; lachakdar. Multi-cloud: mukhtalif providers ki services, maslan analytics ke liye Google Cloud, karobari apps ke liye Azure aur backup ke liye AWS; ek provider par inhisar (dependency) nahi, zyada mazboot.

items: Deployment models: Public, Private, Hybrid, Multi-Cloud.
Har model ka control, security aur flexibility alag.
